description: Removes a version of a Sitecore item.

archive.description: Moves the items to the archive rather than recycle bin.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to remove version for. Supply this or path.

language.description: Language that should be deleted form the provided item. Language parameter supports globbing so you can delete whole language groups using wildcards.

maxRecentVersions.description: Trims the selected language to value specified by this parameter.

path.description: The path of the item to remove version for (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

recurse.description: Removes language versions from the item and all of its children.

version.description: Version that should be deleted form the provided item. Version parameter supports globbing so you can delete whole version groups using wildcards.

name: common-remove-item-version
